# Statutory Pay

> Free calculators of statutory employment rights in the United Kingdom for the 2026/27 tax year: redundancy pay, notice, holiday entitlement and holiday pay, maternity, paternity, shared parental and adoption pay, and Statutory Sick Pay, for Great Britain and Northern Ireland. Published by Radif Partners. Every figure is read in legislation.gov.uk, HMRC rates and thresholds, GOV.UK, Acas or nidirect, and dated in one parameter file. Calculations run in the browser.

## Pages

- [Radif Partners and Statutory Pay: Who Checks These Figures](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/about/): Who publishes Statutory Pay, why its calculators start from real dates, how the 2026/27 figures are checked, how the site is funded and how to report an error.
- [Adoption Pay Calculator 2026/27: SAP £194.32 After 6 Weeks](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/adoption-pay-calculator/): Adoption pay calculator 2026/27: Statutory Adoption Pay for 39 weeks, 6 at 90% of earnings then £194.32 or 90%, from the matching week, with leave dates.
- [Bank Holidays 2026 and 2027: Annual Leave Rules by Nation](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/bank-holidays-and-annual-leave/): Bank holidays 2026 and 2027 for England and Wales (8), Scotland (10) and Northern Ireland (10): whether you get the day off, extra pay, and pro rata leave.
- [Holiday Notice Period 2026: Booking, Refusal and Shutdowns](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/booking-holiday-notice/): Holiday notice period rules in 2026: ask 3 days ahead for 1 day off, 11 days for a week; an employer refusing needs 6 days; contracts can change both.
- [Carry Over Holiday 2026/27: 8 Days, Sick Leave, 18 Months](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/carry-over-holiday/): Carry over holiday in 2026/27: up to 8 days by agreement, 20 days after sickness to use within 18 months, and all of it if your employer gave you no chance.
- [Company Sick Pay vs SSP 2026: What the Contract Adds](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/company-sick-pay-vs-ssp/): Company sick pay vs SSP in 2026: a scheme can pay more but never less than £123.25 a week or 80% of pay; how full and half pay weeks combine with SSP.
- [Employment Status Rights 2026: Employee, Worker or Freelance](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/employment-status-rights/): Employment status in 2026: employees get notice and up to £22,530 redundancy pay, workers get holiday and statutory pay, the self-employed neither. Agency too.
- [Enhanced Maternity Pay 2026: Company Schemes vs Statutory](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/enhanced-maternity-pay/): Enhanced maternity pay in 2026: how company schemes include SMP at £194.32, full and half pay compared over 39 weeks, and repayment clauses if you leave.
- [Final Pay Calculator 2026: Notice, Holiday, Redundancy Pay](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/final-pay-calculator/): Final pay calculator for 2026: add redundancy pay, notice or pay in lieu, untaken holiday and arrears, and see what sits inside the £30,000 tax-free threshold.
- [Fit Note Rules 2026: 7 Days Self-Certified, Then Proof](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/fit-note-rules/): Fit note rules in 2026: self-certify up to 7 days, then a fit note from a GP, nurse, pharmacist or therapist, free after 7 days; a late note cannot stop SSP.
- [Holiday and Sick Leave 2026: Accrual, Swaps and Carry-Over](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-during-sick-leave/): Holiday and sick leave in 2026: leave builds up while off sick, holiday spoilt by illness can be retaken, up to 20 days carry over, all paid if you leave.
- [Holiday Entitlement Calculator 2026/27: 5.6 Weeks, 28 Days](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-entitlement-calculator/): Holiday entitlement calculator for 2026/27: 5.6 weeks of paid leave in days, hours or shifts, capped at 28 days, pro rata for new starters and leavers.
- [Holiday in the First Year of a Job 2026: Monthly Accrual](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-first-year/): Holiday in the first year of a new job in 2026: one-twelfth of 28 days builds up each month, rounded up to a half day, and how a mid-year start changes it.
- [Holiday on Maternity Leave 2026: Accrual and Bank Holidays](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-on-maternity-leave/): Holiday on maternity leave in 2026: all 28 days keep building up during 52 weeks off, bank holidays included, and untaken leave carries into the next year.
- [Holiday Pay Calculator 2026/27: 52-Week Average, Overtime](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-pay-calculator/): Holiday pay calculator for 2026/27: a week’s pay averaged over the last 52 paid weeks, with regular overtime and commission for the first 4 weeks of leave.
- [Holiday Pay With Overtime and Commission 2026: What Counts](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-pay-overtime-commission/): Holiday pay with overtime and commission in 2026: regular overtime, commission and seniority pay count for the first 4 weeks of leave, averaged over 52 weeks.
- [Holiday Pay When Leaving 2026/27: The (A × B) − C Formula](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/holiday-pay-when-leaving/): Holiday pay when leaving a job in 2026/27: untaken leave paid with (A × B) − C, based on 5.6 weeks a year, and owed even after dismissal for gross misconduct.
- [Employment Rights UK 2026/27: Redundancy, Holiday, SMP, SSP](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/): Employment rights UK 2026/27 worked out from your real dates: redundancy pay (cap £751), notice, holiday pay, SMP at £194.32 and sick pay at £123.25, GB and NI.
- [Irregular Hours Holiday Calculator 2026/27: 12.07 % Accrual](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/irregular-hours-holiday-calculator/): Irregular hours holiday calculator for 2026/27: leave accrues at 12.07 % of hours worked each pay period, rounded to the nearest hour, up to 28 days. GB only.
- [Keeping in Touch Days 2026/27: 10 KIT Days and Your SMP](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/keeping-in-touch-days/): Keeping in touch days in 2026/27: 10 KIT days on maternity or adoption leave, 20 SPLIT days on shared parental leave, how they are paid and when SMP is lost.
- [Lay-Off and Short-Time Working 2026: £41 Guarantee Pay](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/lay-off-short-time-redundancy/): Lay-off and short-time working in 2026: guarantee pay of £41 a day for up to 5 days in 3 months, and a redundancy claim after 4 weeks in a row or 6 in 13.
- [Maternity Allowance 2026/27: £194.32 a Week if No SMP](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/maternity-allowance/): Maternity Allowance 2026/27: up to £194.32 a week for 39 weeks if you earned £30 a week in 13 of the 66 weeks before the due week. Self-employed rules too.
- [Maternity Leave Dates Calculator 2026: Start, Notice, Return](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/maternity-leave-dates-calculator/): Maternity leave dates for 2026 and 2027: 52 weeks from your chosen start, earliest 11 weeks before the due week, notice deadline and the day you return.
- [Maternity Pay Calculator 2026/27: SMP Week by Week, £194.32](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/maternity-pay-calculator/): Maternity pay calculator 2026/27: SMP for 39 weeks, 6 at 90% of pay then £194.32 or 90%, with your qualifying week, eligibility check and every weekly pay date.
- [Statutory Pay Formulas 2026/27: Our Method, Sources, Tests](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/method/): Method of the Statutory Pay calculators for 2026/27: the statute each formula applies, the dates that fix caps and rates, the tests run and the limits.
- [Neonatal Care Pay 2026/27: Up to 12 Weeks at £194.32](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/neonatal-care-pay/): Neonatal care pay and leave in 2026/27: one week per 7 days in neonatal care, up to 12 weeks, paid at £194.32 or 90% of earnings, added to maternity leave.
- [Northern Ireland Employment Rights 2026: How They Differ](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/northern-ireland-employment-rights/): Northern Ireland employment rights in 2026: £783 redundancy cap, paternity leave after 26 weeks, 10 bank holidays, 12-week holiday pay and the same SSP.
- [Notice Period Calculator 2026: 1 to 12 Weeks, Your Last Day](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/notice-period-calculator/): Notice period calculator for 2026: statutory notice of 1 to 12 weeks under ERA s.86 against your contract, your last day of work and the gross value of notice.
- [Parental Bereavement Pay 2026/27: Two Weeks at £194.32](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/parental-bereavement-pay/): Parental bereavement leave and pay in 2026/27: two weeks within 56 weeks, paid at £194.32 or 90% of earnings; in Northern Ireland miscarriage is now covered.
- [Part-Time Holiday Entitlement 2026/27: 5.6 × Days Worked](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/part-time-holiday-entitlement/): Part-time holiday entitlement in 2026/27: 5.6 times the days you work, so 16.8 days on a three-day week, plus your pro-rata share of bank holidays given on top.
- [Paternity Leave 2026: Day-One Right, Two Separate Weeks](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/paternity-leave-day-one/): Paternity leave 2026: a day-one right in Great Britain since 6 April 2026, 2 weeks within 52 weeks, after shared parental leave too. Notice and NI rules.
- [Paternity Pay Calculator 2026/27: SPP at £194.32, GB and NI](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/paternity-pay-calculator/): Paternity pay calculator 2026/27: SPP of £194.32 or 90% for 1 or 2 weeks, 26 weeks’ service and £129 earnings, and day-one leave in GB since April 2026.
- [Payment in Lieu of Notice 2026: PILON Tax and What It Covers](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/payment-in-lieu-of-notice/): Payment in lieu of notice in 2026: when a PILON clause applies, what it covers, why the £30,000 threshold never covers it and how it shifts the redundancy date.
- [Redundancy Consultation 2026: 30 or 45 Days, HR1, Award](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-consultation/): Redundancy consultation in 2026: 30 days for 20 to 99 job losses, 45 days for 100 or more, form HR1, and a protective award of up to 180 days’ pay each.
- [Redundancy on Maternity Leave 2026: 18-Month Protection, SMP](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-maternity-leave/): Redundancy during pregnancy or maternity leave in 2026: priority for suitable jobs until 18 months after birth, SMP of £194.32 kept, pay on normal earnings.
- [Redundancy Pay Calculator 2026/27: Cap £751, GB and NI](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-pay-calculator/): Redundancy pay calculator for 2026/27: enter your dates, get statutory pay with the £751 cap (£783 in NI), the section 145(5) date and each year counted.
- [Redundancy Pay Cap 2026/27: £751 a Week, £783 in NI](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-pay-cap/): Redundancy pay cap for 2026/27: a week’s pay is limited to £751 (£783 in NI) when notice ends from 6 April 2026, so the most anyone can get is £22,530.
- [Northern Ireland Redundancy Pay 2026: £783 Cap, £23,490 Max](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-pay-northern-ireland/): Redundancy pay in Northern Ireland for 2026/27: weekly pay capped at £783, maximum £23,490, the 1996 Order, past caps and claims to an industrial tribunal.
- [Redundancy Pay Table 2026/27: Ready Reckoner, Ages 18 to 64](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-pay-table/): Redundancy pay table for 2026/27: the statutory ready reckoner in weeks for ages 18 to 64 and 2 to 20 years, then times weekly pay capped at £751 (£783 in NI).
- [Redundancy Pay Tax 2026/27: the £30,000 Threshold Explained](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-pay-tax/): Redundancy pay tax in 2026/27: the first £30,000 of redundancy payments is not taxed, notice and holiday pay are, and employers pay 15 % Class 1A above it.
- [Redundancy Relevant Date 2026: Notice, PILON and s.145(5)](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-relevant-date/): Redundancy relevant date in 2026: the day notice ends fixes the £751 cap, while pay in lieu adds up to 12 weeks of statutory notice to your service and age.
- [Time Off to Look for Work in Redundancy 2026: the 40 % Rule](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-time-off-job-hunting/): Time off to look for work in redundancy notice, 2026: reasonable time off after two years’ service, but only 40 % of a week’s pay must be paid in total.
- [Redundancy Pay With Variable Pay 2026: the 12-Week Average](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/redundancy-variable-pay/): Redundancy pay when your pay varies, 2026: the 12-week average, which weeks count, commission, overtime, shifts and furlough, all capped at £751 a week.
- [Resignation Notice Period 2026: 1 Week Minimum and Last Day](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/resignation-notice-period/): Resignation notice period in 2026: the law asks 1 week after 1 month of service unless the contract says more; last day, garden leave, quitting early.
- [Rolled-Up Holiday Pay 2026/27: The 12.07 % Uplift Explained](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/rolled-up-holiday-pay/): Rolled-up holiday pay in 2026/27: a 12.07 % uplift paid with wages, only for irregular-hours and part-year workers in Great Britain, shown on the payslip.
- [Shared Parental Pay Calculator 2026/27: 50 Weeks to Share](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/shared-parental-pay-calculator/): Shared parental pay calculator 2026/27: up to 50 weeks of leave and 37 weeks of pay at £194.32 or 90% of earnings, split between the two parents as you choose.
- [SMP Average Weekly Earnings 2026/27: How the 8 Weeks Work](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/smp-average-weekly-earnings/): SMP average weekly earnings in 2026/27: the paydays that count, monthly pay × 12 ÷ 52, bonuses and sick pay included, and the £129 lower earnings limit test.
- [SSP Changes April 2026: Day-One Sick Pay and the 80% Rule](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/ssp-changes-april/): SSP changes from 6 April 2026: no 3 waiting days, no £125 earnings limit, a rate of £123.25 or 80% of pay, and transitional rules for spells running across.
- [SSP Linked Periods 2026/27: the 8-Week Rule and 28 Weeks](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/ssp-linked-periods/): SSP linked periods in 2026/27: spells 8 weeks or less apart count as one, sharing 28 weeks of sick pay, with a 3-year limit and form SSP1 by week 23 of SSP.
- [SSP for Part-Time Workers 2026/27: Short Weeks and Two Jobs](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/ssp-part-time-multiple-jobs/): SSP for part-time workers in 2026/27: paid from day one with no earnings limit, the lower of £123.25 and 80% of pay per job, and daily rates for short weeks.
- [Statutory Maternity Pay 2026/27: Who Qualifies, How Much](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/statutory-maternity-pay/): Statutory Maternity Pay 2026/27: earn £129 a week, 26 weeks with your employer, then 39 weeks of pay at 90% and £194.32. Proof, notice, leaving and pay rises.
- [Statutory Notice Period 2026: The Week-by-Year Scale to 12](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/statutory-notice-period/): Statutory notice period in 2026: 1 week after a month, then a week per complete year up to 12, pay if sick or on holiday during notice, and misconduct.
- [Statutory Redundancy Pay 2026/27: Who Gets It, Up to £22,530](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/statutory-redundancy-pay/): Statutory redundancy pay in 2026/27: two years’ service, 0.5 to 1.5 weeks per year by age, weekly pay capped at £751 (£783 in NI), exclusions and deadlines.
- [SSP Calculator 2026/27: Sick Pay From Day One, £123.25](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/statutory-sick-pay-calculator/): SSP calculator 2026/27: sick pay from the first day off, the lower of £123.25 a week and 80% of earnings, split by pay week, with the 28-week limit counted.
- [Statutory Sick Pay 2026/27: £123.25 a Week or 80% of Pay](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/statutory-sick-pay/): Statutory Sick Pay in 2026/27: £123.25 a week or 80% of earnings if lower, from the first day off, up to 28 weeks, for UK employees and agency workers.
- [Suitable Alternative Employment 2026: the 4-Week Trial Rule](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/suitable-alternative-employment/): Suitable alternative employment in 2026: valid offers, the 4-week trial, retraining extensions and when a refusal loses redundancy pay of up to £22,530.
- [Term-Time Holiday Entitlement 2026: Part-Year Rule, 12.07 %](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/term-time-part-year-holiday/): Term-time and part-year holiday entitlement in 2026: leave accrues at 12.07 % of hours worked in Great Britain, at most 28 days, rolled-up pay allowed.
- [Unpaid Parental Leave 2026: 18 Weeks per Child, Day One](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/unpaid-parental-leave/): Unpaid parental leave in 2026: 18 weeks per child up to age 18, 4 weeks a year, a day-one right in Great Britain since April, one year of service in NI.
- [Voluntary Redundancy 2026: Offers, the Statutory Floor, Tax](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/voluntary-redundancy/): Voluntary redundancy in 2026: the employer chooses who goes, statutory pay (cap £751 a week) is still the floor, and a settlement needs independent advice.
- [Week’s Pay 2026: 12-Week and 52-Week Averages, £751 Cap](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/weeks-pay-explained/): A week’s pay in UK employment law, 2026: fixed pay, variable pay and no normal hours, the 12-week average against the 52-week holiday rule, and the £751 cap.
- [Zero-Hours Holiday Pay 2026: 12.07 % Accrual, 52-Week Pay](https://statutorypay.co.uk/en/zero-hours-holiday-pay/): Zero-hours holiday pay in 2026: leave accrues at 12.07 % of the hours you work, holiday pay averages your last 52 paid weeks, and rolled-up pay is allowed.
